articleTitle: Big Data Forecasting Applied Nearest Neighbor Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Nearest neighbor is a method of approaching the case by calculating the proximity between the new and the old case in order to make the forecasting process. The value of the approach used in Nearest Neighbor itself is a classification approach that searches all training data that is relatively similar to the data test. Each approach calculates all new and old data so that in the process of searching the value of proximity needs testing of Big data in order to find how much time to produce in forecasting based on old cases. This study had been experimented by using 2,500 cases with 1 minute and 52 seconds, 18,000 of which required longer time i.e. 16 minutes and 30 seconds. The differences in the number of the old cases influence the process of time calculation.

articleTitle: Development of Flexible Production Scheduling by Applying Gantt Charts In Manufacturing Module Open Source ERP (Case Study CV. XYZ)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: CV. XYZ is a manufacturing company engaged in the textile industry producing t-shirts, cotton fabrics, and various other textile products. One of the business processes in the CV. XYZ is the production section. The main problems in the production section are the absence of a system that relates between production department and warehouse department in carrying out business processes and does not have any reports. Development of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) can be a solution for CV. XYZ. Odoo is one of open source ERP software that is widely used by various types of companies. The development of CV. XYZ uses the Odoo Quickstart Methodology. This methodology can implement the completion process on time and the costs needed can be adjusted to the project. The purpose of the development of CV. XYZ is to make their business processes can be accessed effectively and efficiently with the flexible production scheduling system. Once the ERP implementation is finished the system is measured using System Usability Scale (SUS) to measure the system usefulness based on the SUS result, the ERP implementation has succeed and acceptable.

articleTitle: Compressive Sampling for Robust Video Watermarking based on BCH Code in SWT-SVD Domain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The security and confidentiality of the data can be guaranteed by using a technique called watermarking. In this study, compressive sampling is designed and analyzed on video watermarking. Before the watermark compression process was carried out, the watermark was encoding the Bose Chaudhuri Hocquenghem Code (BCH Code). After that, the watermark is processed using the Discrete Sine Transform (DST) and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). The watermark insertion process to the video host using the Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT), and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) methods. The results of our system are obtained with the PSNR 47.269 dB, MSE 1.712, and BER 0.080. The system is resistant to Gaussian Blur and rescaling noise attacks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Governance Information System Using Framework Cobit 5 in Banking Company
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The majority of organizations or companies both public and private already use information technology as a support in improving the effectiveness and efficiency of business performance, it can impact on not achieving the business goals of the company. Every banking company in Indonesia is obliged to report monthly reports to Bank Indonesia for financial supervision, but on the use of reporting systems is perceived to be less than optimal. The IS audit control mechanism using this COBIT framework not only provides an evaluation of IT governance in the company, but also provides inputs that can be used to improve its management. COBIT 5 is therefore a benchmark for the process of appraising and improving IT governance. After the mapping obtained 7 processes for the measurement that is EDM02, APO02, APO11, BAI06, DSS01, DSS02, and DSS03. Result of each process, obtained the level of capability of each process EDM02 = Level 1, APO02 = Level 2, APO11 = Level 2, BAI06 = Level 2, DSS01 = Level 2, DSS02 = Level 2, and DSS03 = Level 1. The IT governance gap analysis is done by comparing the current level of IT governance capability with the target level to be achieved.

articleTitle: Batik Image Retrieval Using Maximum Run Length LBP and Sine-Cosine Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper investigates the effectiveness of Maximum Run Length (MRL) from Local Binary Pattern (LBP) for content-based Batik image retrieval system. The MRL of state ‘1’ derived from LBP code has been proven to yield a promising result for image classification task. The features generated from MRL of state ‘1’ have lower dimensionality compared to that of the classical LBP feature even though they are from an identical binary string. The additional color features are added for achieving a high image retrieval accuracy. To further increase the accuracy, the Sine-Cosine Algorithm (SCA) and its variants are further applied in the system to obtain the Optimum Similarity Weights (OSW). As documented in Experimental Section, the fusion of MRL and color features along with OSW significantly improves the retrieval accuracy with low feature dimensionality.

articleTitle: Extraction of P and T Waves from Electrocardiogram Signals with Modified Hamilton Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: A non-invasive method using electrocardiogram (ECG) is a good choice in monitoring and identifying heart condition of a subject. P wave, T wave, and QRS complex represent activity in a certain part of a heart, respectively. Each of the aforementioned wave features has its own characteristics. This makes an extraction process of ECG signals difficult. In this study, the Hamilton Algorithm, which is generally used to detect QRS complex, is modified so that it can detect P and T waves. The experiment results show that the performance in T wave detection is acceptable, with an average of 87.21% over 3 simulated conditions. For the case of P wave detection, improvement to the method is required, since only 52.24% of the P waves are detected at the same simulated conditions.

articleTitle: The Performance of a Three-blades Fish-ridge Turbine in an Oscillating Water Column System for Low Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The turbine power coefficient on the OWC system is determined when the turbine works under compression and suction conditions. The OWC system with VAWT turbines is believed to be suitable for use in low wave areas. In this paper, a design and performance simulation of three-blade of the fish-ridge turbine is applied to the OWC system. The method used is a simulation with CFD to get a profile of the contour of speed and pressure when compression and suction in the chamber. Simulations produce power coefficients, tip speed ratios calculated from wind speed parameters in the chamber, turbine torque, and turbine rotation speed. The results of this study are that there is a difference between airflow velocity and air pressure during compression state or suction state. This difference is due to the airflow in the suction passing through a smaller space than when it is in a compression state. The surface area of the inlet/outlet water is wider than the surface area of the inlet/air outlet. Energy extraction in this OWC system reaches 24.5% at 6.5m/s wind speed, compared to the application of fish-ridge turbines on open systems. The sensitivity of the fish-ridge turbine on the OWC system increased due to two conditions, namely in compression conditions and suction conditions and the presence of small arcs on the turbine blades which facilitate more even distribution of velocity and air pressure.

articleTitle: Assessing Trust Variable Impact on the Information Technology Governance Using Business-IT Alignment Models: A Model Development Study
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Information technology (IT) governance is still a problem for most institutions. IT governance is still something not easy to understand especially to run. Trust is one of the important attributes used as parameters in IT governance. The purpose of this paper is to develop a research model of trust in IT governance implementation model in educational institutions that it is influenced by business strategy and IT alignment as a connecting variable between trust variables and IT governance variables. The method and theories in this study uses the previous studies by adopting, integrating and adapting the business-IT alignment into IT governance trust model then the new model proposed and developed. The new model consists of 4 variables in 5 influential relationships. This study also shows coherent aspects of the process model, the causal model, the questionnaire of each indicator. Determination alignment of business strategies and IT strategies to support IT governance reach of 83% and this result conclude the variable system trust, business strategy and IT strategy has real influenced to IT governance. Therefore, the goal of educational institutions is achieved a good IT governance so the business-IT alignment can be reach.

articleTitle: OBD-II Sensor Approaches for The IMU and GPS Based Apron Vehicle Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This research paper presents the extension of our previous multi-sensor fusion algorithm in order to provide a robust apron vehicle positioning system. Our work showed that the proposed sensor fusion strategy able to accommodate both Inertia Measurement Unit (IMU) and Global Positioning System (GPS) sensors to deliver better position estimation with low error rates. However, higher error tolerance in both sensors remains gaps for improvement. For example, the IMU-Accelerometer drifting effects. By introducing an On-Board Diagnostic-II (OBD-II) sensor to the system, a new parameter which is velocity from the vehicle can be obtained. This velocity parameter is exclusive since it gives an absolute zero value as the vehicle stops. On this paper, we introduce how to update our graded Kalman filter (GKF) algorithm with the new additional OBD-II sensor. Further, we analyze how the new obtained parameter could improve the whole system performances. Our experiment shows that absolute zero velocity feature from OBD-II sensor able to reduce the drifting effect especially when the vehicle is idle (non-moving condition). Moreover, based on the RMSE calculation, the addition of OBD-II sensor is able to reduce the error level of the system.

articleTitle: Electro-tactile Cues for a Haptic Multimedia Finger Motoric Learning System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new haptic multimedia finger motoric learning system. This system is using electro-tactile sensation as haptic cues for enhancing information to the user, in addition to visual and audio information. This system is used to train the users to “type” above a hand tracking device. As each character or each note showed in a screen and sounded from the sound system, the electrical sensation is delivered to the finger, indicating which finger to use to do the action. Subjects who use this system feel that electro-tactile sensation make them response more reflexive and automatic to do the task. The result shows that this system can reduce the time to learn a new finger skill about 20% faster.

articleTitle: The Investigation of a Single-phase Shunt Hybrid Active Power Filter with FCS MPC and Hysteresis Control
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: It is assumed that the harmonics appeared in the electricity grid due to nonlinear loads significantly affect the quality of electric power. This harmonic can be reduced by using a power filter. In this paper, we will discuss the comparison of harmonic decreasing in a single-phase electrical system using the hysteresis method and Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control FCS-MPC. The filter used is a passive series filters connected with active shunt filters. The model simulation made was prepared using Simulink and testing was carried out using two different sets of parameters. From the test results, the Shunt hybrid active power filter decreased harmonics current controlled by hysteresis and FCS-MPC is very significant. Harmonic current before SHAPF installation is 23.92% on the grid, can be reduced by the hysteresis of 1.45%. For FCS-MPC, it is 0.43% and in the second test with the harmonic current before installing SHAPF is 45.59%. This can reduce the harmonic current by the hysteresis method to 1, 72% and for FCS MPC 0.94%. From the test, it can be found FCS MPC method is more effective in reducing current harmonics.

articleTitle: Wood Classification Based on Fiber Texture Using Backpropagation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Indonesia is one of the countries with abundant biological wealth, 125.9 million ha is the forest area in this country. Each type of wood has a different level of quality. Usually in one type of wood is divided into several classes to classify the quality. One type of grouping is through the texture of wood fiber. In the wood industry in Indonesia, the process of sorting wood classes is done by manual visual observation by an expert. This manual observation results in inconsistent product quality, long time, and more expensive costs. With these problems, a system is designed to classify wood classes based on the texture of the fiber. The type of wood that will be used is Cedar wood. Cedarwood is one type of wood that has very good quality. Its characteristic is to have a strong aroma produced from resin, not easily cracked when formed and has a high level of resistance in all conditions. Cedar wood will be grouped into 3 classes. This study will conduct a classification process of wood class based on the texture of the fiber using the Backpropagation and HOG methods. From the system that has been made produces an accuracy rate of 90%.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligence on Color-Embedded-Grayscale Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The recovery process of color-embedded-grayscale image becomes challenging task since of its ill-posed nature. The recovered color image produced from the color-embedded-grayscale image exhibits unpleasant result. Some important color information are lost in this stage. To overcome this issue, this paper presents a new technique on improving the quality of recovered secret image by means of optimization process. The proposed method exploits the effectiveness of swarm intelligence on finding the optimum adjustment weight. As reported in Experimental Section, the proposed method offers promising result for the color recovery task in terms of subjective and objective measurements. The proposed method yields the mean squared error about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.447\mathbf{E}+08$</tex> over training and testing dataset.

articleTitle: The Increase of Brain Activity in Frontal Lobe After One Hour Methadone Intake
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Narcotics is a very dangerous disease because it can damage the nervous system which change the abuser's personality becomes worse. Uncontrolled use of the drugs can lead to criminal acts, namely by destroying norms, public peace, and national security. Methadone is a synthetic opioid that is medically used as a substitution therapy for drug abusers. Giving doses must be done carefully to avoid the undesirable effect. So far, an instrument that can be used to help a medical treatment of doses methadone have not been found yet. In this study, an instrument for detection of drug effects on brain activity is developed and subsequently can be used as a tool for administering of methadone doses. To see the changes in the brain activity, an experiment is conducted in which the brain signals of 8 narcotics addicted subject is measured: just before, 10 minutes, and one hour after methadone intake. The results of data processing showed that the amplitude in the frontal lobe tended to increase for all subjects (except subject 3) after one hour of methadone intake are obtained.

articleTitle: Prediction Analysis of Student Specialization Suitability using Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Some study programs consist of a core study program and additional programs required by the students to choose a field of specialization related to the disciplines studied. Due to the lack of gathered information about the student's ability as a relevant consideration for choosing a bachelor specialization, a system to analyze the suitability student's specialization is required. An analysis for predicting student's specialization using Artificial Neural Network algorithm therefore, was proposed to provide information about classification for the student based on their competence. The main purposes of this study were to analyze the result of student's specialization prediction using the classification method with Artificial Neural Network algorithm and to analyze the gap between the results of manual selection and the results of the algorithm. The advantages of Artificial Neural Network are its adaptability, nonlinearity, modularity, and openness to noisy, fuzzy, or soft data. The result showed that the accuracy using this process was around 94.81%. Thus, it could bring impacts and benefits for students, educators, and institutions.

articleTitle: Realistic or Iconic 3D Animation (Adaptation Study with Theory Uncanny Valley)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Animation has a significant and massive on the national economy reported by the UNESCO Institute for statistics show from 2005 to 2017. This phenomenon makes urgent need in society about good animation that can appeal to the audience, basically in 3D animation. The purpose of this study is to provide recommendations style for developing an animation work by comparing realistic or iconic 3D animation styles that can appeal to the audience. The study of this paper uses the qualitative method from secondary data in the previous study about uncanny valley style animation, and the author makes comparison study about good animation has appeal in society. The result of this research is expected into the recommendation production process for development 3D animated film between realistic and iconic style development. The conclusion of this research is that the iconic style is better than the realistic style for development 3D animation film, especially for the growing economy country.

articleTitle: Voice Activity Detector for Device with Small Processor and Memory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition needs a lot of computation resources to do all operations necessary to recognize speech. Thus it could not be deployed on devices with small processor and memory. To overcome this problem, a new and simple Voice Activity Detector is needed. This is achieved by combining Raw Speech Signal as input and Deep Neural Network as classifier. Training data is prepared by collecting recorded speech from various speakers and assigning label on them manually. Minimum neural network architecture, in term of number of layer and number of neuron that still provides good detection accuracy, is determined using experiments. The result is an architecture with only 3 layers, 130 neurons, 64 inputs, softmax activation function, Adam optimization, dropout rate 0.2, and batch size 64. The accuracy is 0.7406 for training and 0.7168 for validation.

articleTitle: Identification of Green and Sustainable Campus Indicators in Its Implementation at President University
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Several important points are highlighted in this article encompass the implementation of green and sustainable campus at President University according to UI GreenMetric World University Ranking (UIGMWUR) criteria. The criteria referred to include setting and infrastructure (SI); energy and climate change (EC); waste (WS); water (WR); Transportation (TR) and education (ED). Each of these criteria was elaborated as a number of indicators compiled by mutual agreement between UIGMWUR coordinators and initiators. Reflecting on the results of the assessment in 2018, for each category are, SI reach 15%, EC category reach 25%, WS category reach 21%, WR category reach 0%, TR category reach 36% and ED category reach 46% from the maximum 100% for each. There are plenty things that need to be addressed and improved to realize President University as a green and sustainable campus. An important point that needs to be underlined is, ratification of the UIGMWUR criteria is not only aimed solely at getting the title of a green and sustainable campus, but more towards making the university a driving force for awareness of the importance of preserving our environment.

articleTitle: Parking Service Management with Hybrid Code Technology (HCT)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Technology-based parking service management is an essential requirement in the parking service industry. The main obstacle in a parking service is the improper use of technology such as a server that is not working; the computer network at the gate is not coordinating well, thus making consumers dissatisfied. This paper proposes a solution in the form of technology to support parking services using Hybrid Code Technology (HCT) in billing receipts. The method used is barcode design on billing receipts, so that the parking service system can still provide optimum service when the network is lost. The results of this paper have successfully designed Hybrid Code Technology (HCT) for use in parking services. HCT consists of a unique code that can be used as a feature to distinguish whether a vehicle enters a parking area under normal conditions or when the system fails to work so that even when the computer network is not working, transaction identities can still be saved to the server.

articleTitle: Prototype of Postpaid Electricity and Water Usage Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper presents a prototype design and implementation of home users' postpaid electricity and water usage monitoring system. The system design is consisted of four main components such as Arduino UNO microcontroller and Bluetooth module, current and water flow sensors, RGB LED, and alarm buzzer. Current and water flow sensors will measure the current and water flow driven in installation. Measurement data will be sent to Arduino UNO as microcontroller. Arduino microcontroller will be reading and processing the data. If the current and water usage exceeds the predetermined limits, then microcontroller through Bluetooth module will trigger the RGB LED to light up and then buzzer will sound as a warning to notify users. Three different situations have been applied to test the device performance. The first two is for each electricity and water usage limits. And the third is when both utilities are combined simultaneously. Testing results show that for the first two, acceptable limits of electricity and water usage are at highest points (900 W and 3 L). But, for the third is varied according to the combination between electricity and water usage limits. These results showed that the prototype can be used as an energy monitoring system to warn and notify home users from monthly overdue consumption fees of postpaid electricity and water usage. But, this prototype still needs much improvements to be ready applied as a commercial device.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Naïve Bayes Algorithm for Classifying Tweets Containing Hate Speech with Political Motive
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The mid-of 2018 until the mid-of 2019 has been densely marked with political agendas in Indonesia. This moment has created vulnerability to spread hate speech with political motive which is one of the most commonly encountered as cyber-crime on Indonesia's social media. Twitter, as one of the most popular social medias in Indonesia becomes the target of spreading hate speech. Tweets that are suspected to contain hate speech can be drawn automatically using twitter scraper. Filtering and labeling stage before being classified using Naïve Bayes Algorithm. The classification process is done by using WEKA, so finally the accuracy of Naïve Bayes Algorithm for tweet containing hate speech with political motive can be identified. By using that method, the classification can be started and the particular tweets that include non-political hate speech, hate speech with political motive, or non-hate speech can be identified. Data tweet that has been drawn, should then be processed through the average value from the accuracy is 93.4%.

articleTitle: Mapping and Grouping of Farm Land with Graham Scan Algorithm on Convex Hull Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Information on farm land ownership is important for Indonesia, where some of the population is farmers. The issue of unclear land ownership has caused farmer groups to experience difficulties in organizing activities to increase agricultural production. The land mapping information system can be a solution for farmer groups to see details of land ownership and information on farm land area within their organizing area. In this research a mapping system of farm land was developed and specifically this paper discusses the application of the Graham Scan algorithm to the Convex Hull method for grouping farm land. Based on the results of the system trials before and after using the convex hull, it is known that the grouping of 100 points is faster by an average of 2.44s. Memory usage is also quite good, after using Convex Hull it becomes more efficient 200KB. All results are obtained by comparing the application of the Convex Hull method and without the application of the method.

articleTitle: Design of Distribution Routes Using Saving Matrix Method to Minimize Transportation Cost
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Transportation and distribution is one of the most important aspects in influencing the company success to survive and compete with other companies. First step in the distribution process improvement becomes more efficient, namely by finished goods distribution and various materials in the right time of quantity needed, and in many conditions used, to the location needed, even with the lowest total cost. However, at this moment the building materials company has problems in product distribution. The process of basic building materials transportation in the company is currently still use a trial and error system where the distribution routes are separated from the distribution networks which are widespread increasingly cause the distribution costs increase. For this reason, it is necessary to do a distribution route design to minimize the costs expenditure. Saving matrix method distribution route will reduce 3 routes of U-shape Ready Mix Concrete and 2 routes for O-shape. Transportation cost to distribute U-shape Ready Mix Concrete savings of IDR 628.817,- per month and for O-shape of IDR 922.250,- per month. Transportation cost decreased until 36,15% for U-shape product and 53,02% for O-shape product.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Social Media Users Using Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree, Random Forest Algorithm: A Case Study of Draft Law on the Elimination of Sexual Violence (RUU PKS)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: In this digitalization era, it made it easy for the people of Indonesia to deliver ideas, opinions to carry out campaigns. One real example is regarding the existence of Draft Law on the Elimination of Sexual Violence (RUU PKS) with the aim of creating a new paradigm that ensures the community is free from sexual violence. The draft initiated by the National Commission on Violence Against Women, known as KOMNAS Perempuan, succeeded in becoming a conversation with social media users. Twitter is one of the social media that is a means of delivering public opinion regarding the case. One of the uses of this research is to find out the tendency of Twitter users to comment on regarding the existence of Draft Law on the Elimination of Sexual Violence (RUU PKS) by conducting sentiment analysis. The stages of this research are carried out by collecting data. The data that has been collected will go through the pre-processing, processing stage which will produce data in the positive, negative and neutral categories then testing using confession matrix. From the results of accuracy in the order of naive bayes, decision tree and random forest, the accuracy is 83.94%, 75.31 and 75.72%. Based on this, it can be concluded that the sentiment analysis of this case gets the best results using the Naive Bayes algorithm. As well as based on the results obtained that campaigning through social media has an effect, in this case for the campaign to support the RUU PKS itself produces more positive sentiments.

articleTitle: Stream Control Transportation Protocol (SCTP) towards MANET Routing: Comparison of DSR and AODV
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This research wants to compare the performance of Stream Control Transportation Protocol (SCTP) with two difference mechanism, which are Ad-hoc on Demand Distance Vector (AODV) and Dynamic Source Routing protocol (DSR) by using Network Simulator (NS-2). Specifically, it measures the behavior of SCTP in terms of throughput and smoothness by having assumption that routing protocol in MANET (Mobile Ad-hoc Network) can bring significant effect in SCTP in the overall performance. Actually, IETF (Internet Engineering Task Force), has issued a new protocol called SCTP, which in this study, the interaction of SCTP is investigated through the examination of traffic flows through a number of network topologies. This performance analysis is over MANET Routing Protocol that enables the process of analysis of several performance metrics. The simulation use topology with 16 nodes that is consisting of metric 4×4 of SCTP transport layer for both routing protocol of AODV and DSR. At last, this research have been found that MANET impact less on the throughput of SCTP with only amounted to 0-2% within 5m/s to 25 m/s of simulation area. Furthermore, the speed of node movement does not significantly affect the smoothness as well.

articleTitle: Prototype of Automatic Braking System on Car Model Using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Car braking system is a very important part of car safety. The effectiveness of conventional braking systems is strongly influenced by the ability and experience of the driver. Car accidents can be avoided if the correct amount of brake pressure is applied at the right time. Therefore it is necessary to use automatic braking system that can anticipate accidents. In this automatic braking system, controlling fuzzy logic is needed to determine the percentage value of the brake that will be performed. The inputs on the fuzzy logic are the speed of the car when moving and the distance between the car and the obstacles in front of it. There are 28 rules used in this controlling fuzzy logic. The rules contain comparisons between the speed of the car when moving and the distance between the car and the obstacles in front of it, the resulting the percentage value of the brake that matches the condition of the moving car. The design of this automatic braking system is made in the form of a prototype car using Arduino Uno R3 as the processor. By using fuzzy logic with 28 rules, the system is capable to stop the car even when it runs at low speed or high speed, with a braking distance about 10cm to 5cm.

articleTitle: Solution of the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem using Variable Neighborhood Search with Threshold
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) arises in daily logistics problem. Here a set of customers are served by a number of similar vehicles originated from a depot. The aim is to find the shortest routes to serve the customers. An adaptation of the variable neighborhood search (VNS) is used to solve the CVRP. In the algorithm, a threshold is applied in the shaking procedure. A number of neighborhood and local searches are used in the searching process. In the local search, the first improvement search strategy is used. Five instances from literature are used to test the proposed algorithm. The solutions produced are good, as the average deviation obtained by the proposed algorithm is just 0.04% less than the average deviation of the recently published CVRP paper.

articleTitle: The Relation between Internet Use and Societal Development in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: We seek to explore the plausible relation between internet use on one hand, and human development index (HDI) and crime incidence on the other in Indonesia. By using numbers reported in Statistical Yearbook Indonesia 2018 by BPS, the regression model reveals that internet is positively related to the increment of HDI level. However, internet use is also positively related to the number of crime incidence; meaning more crimes with internet use. The year 2017 seems to be an interesting year to investigate more deeply, as it is negatively related to both HDI level and number of crime incidence. These results are robust to unemployment rate and labor participation conditions during 2015 thru 2017. These findings reveal differentiated relations between internet use and current societal development in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Bottleneck Reduction at The Shoes Production Line using Theory of Constraints Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper deals with an imbalance problem in a shoes company that produces the upper and bottom soles at two production lines, and then they are assembled at the assembly line. The imbalance is caused by bottlenecks at the one site of the production lines. It occur waste of waiting at the next process, i.e. the assembly line. It impacts the production target cannot be met, while throughput cannot be maximized. In this paper, the bottlenecks are managed by Theory of Constraints (TOC) approach that adopt linear programming to optimize the production planning, and adopt the Drum Buffer Rope (DBR) to control the flow of production. The buffers are determined by considering the output gap between the two production lines. This paper also proposes 3 solution alternatives to meet the production target. The main goal of this research is the implementation of Theory of Constraints concepts to reduce imbalance problem at the bottleneck work stations. The result shows that application of DBR as well as the three alternatives of proposed overtime based on the optimal production rate can reduce the problem of imbalance between upper and outsole at the shoe production lines from 18.96% to 4.28%.

articleTitle: Analog Behavioral Model of Underdamped Free Oscillation of Cantilever Beams
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: A physical model representing an underdamped free oscillation of a cantilever beam is constructed. The model is incorporated into a pSPICE Analog Behavioral Model (ABM) in order to construct a circuit schematic that generates a model-based waveform representing that of the experiment. A strain gage is employed to sense the change in strain in the oscillating cantilever beam. The frequency and damping ratio of oscillation of the cantilever are determined by means of curve fitting. Experiment and pSPICE ABM results show an excellent agreement.

articleTitle: Enterprise Architectural Design Based on Cloud Computing using TOGAF (Case Study: PT. TELIN)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The implementation of systems and information technology has become the company's main strategy to remain able to compete in an increasingly competitive business climate. Information systems have a role to help manage business processes effectively and efficiently. Case studies on PT XYZ companies show that the use of IS / IT has not been optimal in supporting the sustainability of its business processes. This is due to the absence of information technology architecture planning that is aligned with the company's business strategy, especially related to the Enterprise Architecture (EA) which consists of Business Architecture, Data Architecture, Application Architecture and Technology Architecture. Business processes and organizational activities. This study aims to design cloud computing-based Enterprise Architecture (EA) for PT. TELIN using the TOGAF ADM method as a framework. The integration between Enterprise Architecture (EA) and cloud computing brings great benefits to the company. Cloud Computing provides elasticity in software and hard solutions in organizations, while Enterprise Architecture (EA) guarantees compatibility between business strategies and IT strategies. This study produced the architectural design of the company PT. TELIN is done by looking at business strategies in the process of production and product distribution with the aim of supporting the implementation of the company's information system as a whole, resolving the problem of information system integration, and increasing effectiveness and efficiency in the implementation of information technology infrastructure.

articleTitle: Data Mining Based Privacy Attack Through Paper Traces
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Privacy can be revealed from many sources, since data is available in papers and digital forms. Many techniques available to infer some private data based on these available sources, for example, data mining techniques. In this paper, it is investigated whether it is possible to derive some private information from shopping receipts, which are paper traces of people activities. Since people do not think that shopping receipts may harm them, usually they do not keep these shopping receipts safely. The techniques used in this research are data mining techniques; classification and clustering algorithm. In this first stage of research, the aim of this research is to determine whether it is possible to classify shopping data to correct shopper profiles, and to separate a set of shopping data into two meaningful groups, according to the shopping profiles. From the results, it can be concluded that it is possible to predict to which profile the data belongs to, with the percentage of data correctly classified higher than 97%. It also can be concluded that it is possible to separate the shopping receipts data into two groups, where each group represents each profile.

articleTitle: Semi-Automatic Machine with Programmable Logic Controller in the Mendong Woven industrial
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The focus of this paper is to propose a design of semi-automatic saving mendong (Fimbristylis umbellaris) weaving machines using a programmable logic controller (PLC). The background of this paper is that mendong weaving machines are tools used in producing mendong mats, but until now, the machines used are still manual. The proposed method is to design a machine using a PLC as the central controller by using six ultrasonic sensors and a DC motor to drive the lever to mendong weaving. This paper concludes that the total electrical power consumed by three systems is 42.38 watts without load, and 104.59 watts with a load. The most significant sequential electricity consumption is the pressing system, then the roll-up system and the lowest in the embroider system. Based on the results of testing separately, the components used are Mechanical devices, PLC, power supply, ultrasonics sensors, DC motor drive that works well. The overall test is a weaving time of 42.5 minutes with a length of webbing of 1 meter, spending 37.27 WH.

articleTitle: Smart Postpaid Electricity Meter Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Manually dealing with electricity meters takes time because someone needs to access the postpaid electricity customer premises. Dealing with customers who fail to pay their electricity bills will be more complicated because specific action needs to be taken to cut off the power lines. A smart postpaid electricity meter is proposed in this research to overcome the above problems. This system is designed not only to record data of the amount of electricity usage but also to take action to cut off the electricity when the customer is in arrears. Arduino as a microcontroller is applied as the main control process. Internet of Things (IoT) technology is adopted to make the meter be controlled remotely through internet access. Required features and functionalities of the system are identified first before designing the system. Coding is written base on the design result. Unit test followed by integration test will be conducted to measure whether iteration steps are required or not. The test result shows that all proposed meter functions work well, so it can be said that the project works as expectations and the meter is ready to be used nationwide replacing the previous one.

articleTitle: Development of a Simple Ultrasonic Motor Driver
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This study mainly designed a simple driver for a circular cylindrical ridge-wave ultrasonic motor (RW-USM). Compared with a conventional switching resonant converter drive circuit, the drive circuit presented in this study was designed with IC-type components utilized to form a phase shifter that, in turn, was used to obtain two waveform signals with a 90-degree difference. In addition, two APEX PB50 ICs are used in the design of the amplifier circuit, which amplifies the two aforementioned signals by 11 times to drive the RW-USM. At a drive frequency of 34.868 KHz, a drive voltage of 200 Vp-p, and a preload of 1 N, an RW-USM utilizing the presented driver was found to have a maximum speed of 104.981 rpm, a maximum output torque of 3.957 mN.m, and an electromechanical transform ratio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\eta$</tex> that was increased from 16% to 22%. The simulation and experimental results show that the presented simple IC-type driving circuit is very suitable for use in RW-USM.

articleTitle: Counting of Aedes Aegypti Eggs using Image Processing with Grid Search Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Dengue fever is an epidemic brought by infected Aedes Aegypti. This disease has often threatened public health and even caused death. One way to control it is by monitoring the number of its eggs. In this paper, a model for calculating the number of Aedes Aegypti eggs using a camera is made by applying image processing. Steps for processing this image consists of several stages, namely the transformation to HSV, segmentation of objects, labeling of objects, removing small objects, closing holes in objects, and calculating many eggs. To improve accuracy, the parameters in the segmentation, cleaning and closing processes are optimized using Grid Search. The results obtained showed a better average accuracy of 99%.

articleTitle: Packaging Local Identity: Redesigning the Brand and Package of Tenteng Malino of South Sulawesi
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: In this study, the researcher discussed about Tenteng Malino: a traditional snack from Malino, South Sulawesi. The researcher found two problems which related to its brand and package. First, Tenteng Malino did not have a strong brand identity and second, package, as the Tenteng Malino only wrapped with the used printed label and common plastic. The objective of the research is to increase the sale of the Tenteng Malino by redesigning the brand and package of the Tenteng Malino. The result of this research is the package design for Tenteng Malino, which is designed in an informative and persuasive manner.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Continuous and Periodic Review on Inventory Components of Dump Trucks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Proper inventory planning can facilitate smooth the production process. It will minimize the problem of out of stock and over stock. The case company has a problem in controlling the availability of components, namely the occurrence of shortages of stock that caused the production process disrupted. The ABC analysis method is used to see the classification of components often out of stock. Inventory planning methods with continuous review and periodic review method were compared to determine optimal ordering lots, and reorder points. It also examined inventory policies, namely service level, safety stock, ordering costs, holding costs, and cost due to possible shortages. The results showed that for this particular problem continuous review is better than periodic review. It offered saving of the total inventory costs 16% of the actual inventory cost. Whereas, for the periodic review method saved of 6% of the actual cost of inventory.

articleTitle: Sound Visualization Using Typography Composition Based GIF
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Visual communication design is a creative communication process, in which it combines art to encode and decode the message. As the technology advances, visual design communication explore further, paving ways to visualize something that doesn't have the visual attribute; sound, something that can only be perceived through auditory senses. The sound is transformed by controlling symbols, images, color & movement into an image, using a visual programming software combined with typography composition, to create GIF (Graphic Interchange Format) as the final product. Sound visualization opens the possibility to experience sounds without even hearing it. It is an experimental tool to experience sound, to give an even deeper meaning of a message, and to bridge the possibilities to convey sound to the hearing impairment, those who carry disability, expanding the minds and horizon so they can experience sound.

articleTitle: A Two-Phase Metaheuristic Method for Solving Travelling Repairman Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The traveling repairman problem (TRP) is a variant of the traveling salesman problem (TSP). TRP is more complicated than TSP because this problem aims to minimize the cost related to vehicle arrival times at customers. This problem is suitable for the customer-centric case to increase the customer satisfaction level. In the TRP, heuristic or metaheuristic methods can be used to solve the problem. Previous published researches show that a record-to-record travel algorithm (RRT) has been proven to have good results. RRT has never been used in previous TRP case. So, this paper aims to propose a two-phased metaheuristic method based on RRT algorithm to solve TRP model. This paper uses several local searches in two movement mechanisms (uphill and downhill moves), TRP general structure, and parameter value for iteration has been modified. A small dataset from previous researches is used to test the proposed algorithm. The experiment shows that the proposed algorithm produces good results (average deviation compared to best known result only 1.48%).

articleTitle: The Mapping of Strategic Concept Through 5C Model Theory as a Visual Communication Design Tool for Jakarta City Branding
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Generating an effective branding for a city with high cultural diversity and complex problem such as Jakarta requires an integrated concept to the system of local governance, stakeholder, business development of future plan and also the acceptance from the citizen. This project-led research will use the theory of 5C model as the basic approach to extract the various design experimentation, analysis and data visualization. The final outcome is a customized brand mapping for Jakarta city as a visual formulation to measure the complex design factors into more adjustable and unified design concept. As the result, numberuous design factors of Jakarta branding and Jakarta tourism could be integrated using the power of design knowledge. In a longer term, the brand mapping is expected to raise the city's tourism global rank effectively.

articleTitle: Building Industrial Symbiosis at Automotive Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Industry symbiosis is an environmental management approach that is part of industrial ecology, which looks at the exchange of materials, energy, water and by products. Implementation of industrial symbiosis was begun with synergy and collaboration. The aim of this research were to analyse the influenced of synergy and collaboration to material, energy, by product and water exchange among component automotive companies. Population used in this research was component automotive company that located at Greater Jakarta (Jabodetabek). Purposive sampling was used to get sample and used questionnaire to collect data. Number of sample was 32 companies and analysed method was used multiple regression model with t and F test to showed the impact. The results were showed synergy influenced on material exchange. Energy exchange did not influenced by synergy and collaboration. Material exchange happen at supply chain, because the relationship among component automotive company based on fulfilling the input material.

articleTitle: Machine Tonnage Optimization by Reused Scrap Material Applied for Car Propeller Shaft Guard
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to analyze how the scrap material or metal scrap can be reused as a regular material in a production process. The reused scrap material is prepared to use in propeller shaft guard production. This propeller shaft guard is used with the main function to guard the propeller shaft in the car. Therefore, calculating the total mass of the scrap material and propeller shaft guard is needed to know the ratio of the usage of material, the machine tonnage calculation for propeller shaft guard production using reused scrap material, and the new design for blanking material. The total machine tonnage for producing propeller shaft guard using reused scrap material is 260.09 T. The new design for the propeller shaft guard can fit the reused scrap blanking material is created. The total usage of scrap material increased from 49.46% to 79.69% after the material was used in the propeller shaft guard production. The comparison between the condition before and after using reused scrap material as the propeller shaft guard indicates the factors of the total amount of blanking material, the total amount of dies, and dandori are described in this research.

articleTitle: Design and Prototyping The Automatic Fish Feeder Machine for Low Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The focus of this paper is to propose the design of energy-efficient automatic feed machines with reasonable accuracy. This paper also presents the results of measurements of electrical energy consumption. Observations carried out include the consumption of electrical energy in each unit with feed weights of 2 mm and 4 mm. Each feed sample was measured based on electrical energy consumption, optimizing machine work processes for feed weight, and identification of optimization in the ejection system. The results of this study have succeeded in making the design of an automatic feeder machine have been proposed with the performance characteristics being that the total electrical energy consumption and the duration of the process for each feed size are 2 mm and 4 mm. Feed size 2 mm with a weight of 2 kg requires a total consumption of electrical energy amounting to 0.085Wh. A feed with a 4 mm size requires electrical energy consumption of 0.0907Wh. The duration of the process for 2 mm feed size with a weight of 2 kg is 1 minute and feed size 4 mm with a weight of 2 kg requires a process duration of 1.2 minutes.

articleTitle: The Validation of Linear Method in Cascade Reservoir System for Prediction of Energy Production
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper discusses the validation of a stochastic model of Thomas and Fearing that applied to energy prediction of three large scale reservoir in west java. They are Saguling Cirata, and Jatiluhur. The Saguling produces 700MW, Cirata produces 500 MW, and Jatiluhur produces 150MW of electricity energy. The method is applied the stochastic model to prediction supply, demand, and energy production for 2000–2005. The primer used the historical data inflow from 1988–2000. The result of the calculation is then compared to the real measurement on 2000–2005. Conclusion of this paper is the average increase number of monthly demand for next year as much as 4.47%. By increasing the number of demand, the need is still fulfilled. The average energy of those reservoirs between 2001 and 2005 is 4,952 GWH, while real energy is 4,638 GWH. The initial period of operation that fulfills optimal requirement is in April because it can fulfill the objective function and its obstacles. There is the increasing number of demand for irrigation need, industry and drinking water and it should become a priority, the movement of reforestation or the maintenance of Drainage Basin of Citarum River in upstream or downstream has to be carried out continuously, so the inflow of each reservoir can be fulfilled.

articleTitle: Development of Automatic CAD Drawing for Tyre Mould Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper presents the development of automatic drawing algorithm to generate CAD drawing automatically based on the tyre parameter being designed. The purpose of the study is to find a way to greatly reduce the time needed for generating a CAD drawing of a tyre mould. The program was developed to be able to run in CATIA V5 CAD software and uses database of tyre parameters gathered both from international standards and mould design best practices. The result shows that the system did the job well and took less than two hours to complete a tyre mould drawing.

articleTitle: Mapping of Communal Waste Water Treatment Plant User Group in Citarum River Areas Using Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Citarum River is the largest and longest river in the province of West Java. The Citarum River flows along 269 km which starts from Situ Cisanti and empties into the Java Sea. The river is contaminated due to waste dumped into the river, one of which is an industrial waste. Thus, the local government needs to provide a Waste Water Treatment Plant (WWTP) that can be used simultaneously by several adjacent industries. The proximity between industries can be seen through mapping of location points using Geographic Information Systems (GIS). This study aims to design a web-based GIS application for determining groups of industries that will use the WWTP simultaneously. GIS application is designed to map industrial location points and placement of WWTP through determination of location coordinates on Google Maps API. Users of this application can see the display of groups of communal WWTPs as well as points that are in a certain area of coverage.

articleTitle: CARDUINO: An Effort Towards Commercial Autonomous Public Vehicles Based On Arduino
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Any low-cost control systems can be established by using Arduino as one of cheap microcontrollers and thus it has an important role in developing a cheap autonomous vehicle. Adding commercial aspects for general use such as other public transportation will make the process of control more complicated. This paper is developing a prototype representing an autonomous vehicle which provides commercial services to the public. IoT is adopted to allow the car be controlled remotely. Tests are carried out to ensure that the prototype meets pre-specified requirements.

articleTitle: Bidik as a Location Midwife & Clinical Search Platform and Health Services to Meet Family Health Needs: Development and Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Along with the development of the times, the development of these technologies also influenced the advances in technology in the world of IT (Information Technology) which also developed rapidly. Mobile phones and smartphones have provided Global Positioning System (GPS) devices. For smartphone users whose gadgets already support GPS, users can find out the current position and search for certain places by utilizing this technology. Location Based Service (LBS) utilizes GPS technology in its application. The purpose of writing this questionnaire is to produce a mobile application that is the search for public clinics and the closest midwives in particular the Tangerang area, in the application feature are public clinics, midwives, there are also names of doctors from each of these public clinics. In this case the author uses the Android mobile operating system for the installation of the application. The application is integrated in google maps services in determining the route between the user and the location of the midwife or clinic. This service using google maps makes it easier for developers to create and describe applications related to location services. With this application the user can find out the location of the nearest midwife and clinic and can see the doctoral schedule we want.

articleTitle: Encryption Application Using Verifiable Secret Sharing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Secret sharing scheme is used to produce a secret key obtained from a calculation against a certain number of keys in a group. The problem occurs when one or more keys in the group are fake or intentionally faked. A verifiable secret sharing system is proposed in this paper so that it detects any fake keys in a group before being used for resulting the right secret key. Initial system definitions are the basis for writing codes in its system development. Units and integration test is implemented when all units of the system is ready. Repetition is applied to its development stages until the test results show that all system functionalities are working as expected and the system has succeeded in detecting fake keys in the group.

articleTitle: A Blue Robotic Sensor for Tech_SAS v1 ROV Depth Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Maintaining the depth position in underwater remotely operated robot is one of the needs in one of the categories in Singaporean Robot Games (SRG). To maintain depth, a sensor that can measure depth is needed. One sensor that can be used is using a depth pressure sensor. Robot Tech_SAS v1 is a small ROV prototype equipped with six thrusters, where four thrusters are configured to adjust pitch, roll and depth control capabilities. In this paper, 30bar pressure sensor from Bluerobotics and a PID control system is used to maintain depth according to the specified setpoint. The experiment is conducted in 50 cm depth aquarium tank, and the results show that the Tech_SAS v1 Robot can maintain depth with an average accuracy of 95.29%.

articleTitle: System Modelling Using Neural Networks with External Recurrence and Exponential Quadratic Cost Function
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: A novel cost function to improve the performance of neural networks in system modelling is proposed in this paper, the exponential quadratic cost function. This cost function combines the strength of penalizing errors exponentially and the feasibility of quadratic function in finding global minima. By applying the exponential quadratic cost function, the learning algorithm is expected to have an improved ability to minimize the difference between system output and model output. Simulations by using a test system with strong nonlinear dynamics were conducted to prove the effectiveness of the proposed cost function. The results show that the network trained using the exponential quadratic cost function performs better in emulating the test system in transient region.

articleTitle: Maintenance Strategy Optimization in Uniformity Machines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: In the process of making tires, many machines are used. The maintenance department always faced with an over-budget situation, where the actual budget usage exceeds the plan. Therefore, determining a maintenance strategy based on a budget must be carried out appropriately. Because it will have an impact on budget preparation and monthly cash flow. Currently, in business unit 6, there is a machine that becomes the concern to the maintenance team, namely uniformity machines. If the machine is experiencing a breakdown, it can disturb the next process. By optimizing the preparation of the budget using Failure Mode and Effect Analysis or FMEA and Integer Programming, cash flow is obtained each month based on activities that are by the budget of $ 30,053.74 approaching the specified budget by the company which is around $ 30,091.61. Thus, this strategy will prevent the over-budget situation to occur to the maintenance team.

articleTitle: Reducing Wasted in Perfume Laboratory Activities using DMAIC Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The perfume preparation laboratory as part of Research and Development department in a chemical industry takes customer orders in form of request of making fragrance or flavors. There are many processes in laboratory; these can be classified into value added as well as non-value-added activities. The processes of making perfume oftentimes happen waiting for raw materials, stock out of raw materials, storage of excess raw materials and repeated pouring activities of raw materials. This study applies Define, Measure, Analyze, Improvement, and Control (DMAIC) methodology, to improve its productivity. The study identifies wastes in laboratory activities. The method also reduced the frequency of raw materials demand by 90% and decreased inventory process time by 90%. It also cut the trial making process consisting of 14 processes into 11 processes and time savings of 104.9 seconds.

articleTitle: Determination of Reactor Diameter of Wastewater Treatment for Vehicle Wash Facilities Using RA 52 Modified Zeolite Filtration Media
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: One of the wastewater from community activities that not processed through a wastewater treatment plant is vehicle wash's wastewater. This wastewater will potentially pollute the water environment and increased the need for dissolved oxygen for chemical processes (COD) and surfactant. To treat this polluted, wastewater treatment plants are needed. One of the wastewater treatment can use filtration or granular media using modified type RA 52 zeolite. The research aims to reduce the levels of surfactant and COD in vehicle wash's wastewater using several reactor diameters and the zeolite filter media in batch system. The filtration reactor used has a media height of 90 cm, and the size of zeolite media is 1 mm. The results showed that the optimal condition was reach on a variation reactor diameter of 10 cm with a contact time of 5 minutes. Efficiency obtained for removing surfactant from wastewater using the zeolite media is 100% from the initial concentration of 351.81 mg/L and for reducing COD levels with efficiency of 99.84% from the initial results of 4597.94 mg/L. The filtration results can meet the standard requirements set by the Republic of Indonesia Minister of Environment Regulation Number 5 of 2014.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet of Things Based Remote Monitoring System at Electrical Engineering Laboratory in President University
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Monitoring of laboratory in President University is often needed to know some information about the condition of laboratory at any given time, for example the information about the power usage and who accessed the laboratory. This monitoring is made possible to access in real time from anywhere by using the Internet of Things (IoT) Technology. The power monitoring system records the current and the power usage while the Access monitoring system will read and send the information of the card or the tag of the people who entered the lab. Design prototype was constructed by electronic components such as a current sensor, MIFARE RC522 sensor, WEMOS D1 Mini, and WEMOS D1 R1 integrated into the Google Spreadsheet as the cloud of the data stored. Each component was tested before being assembled into a system and the reading accuracy of more than 90% is obtained.

articleTitle: Flow Analysis of Payment Transactions in SAP Reduction of Data with Some Testing Method in PT XYZ
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: PT XYZ expands service with changing business portfolio Fixed, Mobile, and Multimedia (FMM) to Telecommunications, Information, Media and Edutainment (TIME) to be competitive in the telecommunications market. POTS services are one of those services with fixed wireline and indiehome broadband are the main products. It due to customers needs a wireline telephone service with fast connectivity. This development provided directly increase the number of customers. Accordingly, the SAP database on the currently PT XYZ server has been taking the data with large capacity. This resulted in an SAP system in organization impaired operation within a certain period (downtime). To overcome the problems, PT XYZ performs data reduction of the payment transaction from current server to a new server. A process is needed to ensure that each transaction unit using reduced and migrated data to run properly on the new server. Therefore, a testing process is needed to test every unit of the payment transaction data reduction. Tests were conducted using a black-box test, system integration test, and user acceptance test to determine if there are defects or bugs in the system. The expected results in this study are an analysis of system testing of SAP applications.

articleTitle: The Performance of Microcontroller Equipment to Save Fuel Consumption for Motorcycle
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The motorcycle is one of the most vehicles as a means of transportation for Indonesians today. It can be said that almost all motorcycles use gasoline. Overall, this condition is quite large and absorbs national fuel consumption. This study aims to develop a technique in order to save fuel consumption on a motorcycle by installing microcontroller equipment. Tests are carried out on the highway in at varying speeds from 30 km/h to 80 km/h. Testing is done by comparing the consumption of gasoline fuel on a motorcycle before and after using a microcontroller. The research results show that there is saving in gasoline fuel consumption on a motorcycle after using a microcontroller. The fuel saving ranges from 15% to 45% for each variation in engine speed.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Tamarindus Indica Seeds Kernel as Natural Coagulant for Color Removal of Synthetic Textile Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This study describes preliminary study of tamarind seeds kernel powder as natural coagulant for color removal of drimarene dark red (DDR) synthetic wastewater (20 mg/L). The effect pH (2-7), dosage (1-3 g/L), and their interactions were investigated using general factorial design. The seeds powder was also characterized using Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) to observe the possible active coagulating agent in this study. It was found that the seeds powder contained protein that could act as coagulant. Dosage, pH, and their interactions were found to be statistically significant to the removal of DDR. Highest removal of 84.60% was obtained at pH 3 and dosage 3 g/L.

articleTitle: Waste To Energy Foeus On Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Waste from human endeavours has multiplied many fold over the past decades in parallel with growth in population, which has increased nearly four times over the past eighty years. Not unnaturally this has led to a massive increase in the amount of waste generated, both organic and inorganic. At the same time technological improvements have developed steadily, one consequence being the output of large quantities of waste that are strong and non-biodegradable. An increasing portion of this has also been finding its way into marine situations, leading to potential serious hazards affecting the marine linked food chain. Consequently, more attention is now being paid towards means of eliminating hazardous waste or using/reducing it to safe levels. This paper examines the current status of methods to deal with waste, either in terms of elimination or to turn it into something that can be safely reused. Particular focus will be on production of energy or energy providing products, with reference to the situation in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Design of Testing Results of Reduction and Migration of Write Off Transaction Data in POTS Segment Using Integration Testing on SAP Application: Study Case : PT. Telkom Indonesia Tbk
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: PT Telkom Indonesia is the largest telecommunication provider in Indonesia. There are many transactions carried out to provide services, one of these transactions is Write Off and WS. The number of transactions carried out by Telkom Indonesia and interrelated, Telkom Indonesia requires an Enterprise Resource Planning application, namely SAP, which can help integrate all business processes with each transaction made by Telkom Indonesia. Telkom Indonesia has an increase in customers every year. Most customer increases occur in POTS segmentation, so the data stored on the database server is getting bigger. Larger data can cause performance degradation in the system to load data on the database server and also cause several problems such as the risk of failure when the data backup is getting bigger, the data restoration process is very long so it can affect operational activities. Therefore, data reduction is done on the server and replacing the server to the new device to get more optimal performance. Data on a new device that have been reduced and migrated must be tested against related transactions in SAP to see if the data is consistent. Testing is done using System Integration Testing to make sure data being migrated is consistent.

articleTitle: The Effect of Customer Active Participation and Satisfaction for Hotel Facebook Pages Management Effectiveness: A Replication Study
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This replication study has a purpose to compare the research results of effectiveness marketing outcomes, including community promotion and behavior change, of the hotel Facebook pages that already conducted from previous study in USA. This replication study targeted to the different population to expand the respondents that located in Indonesia to find whether the result can be generalized in different context. This research uses a quantitative method with respondents who have ever become a member of hotel Facebook pages in Jakarta. Similar with the USA context, the result of this replication study with Indonesian context proved that active participation does not influence the behavioral change and community promotion <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{p}-\mathbf{value} > 0,05)$</tex>. However, there is a different result with the original study regarding insignificant relationship between active participation toward community promotion in Indonesian context. The original study shows that active participation positively influences community promotion <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{p}-\mathbf{value}< 0.05)$</tex> while the relationship is insignificant in Indonesian context <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{p}-\mathbf{value}> 0.05)$</tex>.

articleTitle: Determination of Technical Characteristics in Panel Button and Control Seat Using Quality Function Deployment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Every company competes with each other to produce products are in accordance with the customer demands and they have competitiveness with other companies. Incidentally, innovative product growth is important for company business consequently applicable choice creation is of tall rate. Later, customer-oriented and knowledge-based products growth is dynamic position. For this purpose, the presentation of knowledge and information based on a specific time, location and template to develop for new products progress is necessary to support effective decision making within companies. The study was intended to determine the technical characteristics of panel button and control sheet using QFD (Quality Function Deployment) method. The panel button and control seat of control cabin have an important role in the aluminium furnace process. The panel buttons and control seat have 6 technical characteristics, namely range button, operator arm angle, button position, dimensional conformity, durability and maintainability. The result using QFD method produces 3 attributes of the most technical characteristics that influence the consumers wish, namely range button, operator arm angle, and button position. The value of the equal of difficulty, the degree of importance and the cost estimation of range button sequentially are 3,19,13. The value of the level of difficulty, the degree of importance and the cost estimation for operator arm angle sequentially are 4,17,17. The value of the level of difficulty, degree of importance and cost estimation sequentially for button position are 4,18,17. The three attributes that most influence production are selected based on the value accumulation of level of difficulty, degree of importance and the cost estimation

articleTitle: Stability Analysis in a Technology Transfer Model with Competing Followers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: We present the stability analysis for solution of a mathematical model of technology transfer. The model takes form in a system of differential equations. We assume that there are two competing followers with logistic growth function of technological development for all parties involved. The analysis of the model is done via dynamical system approach by emphasizing the long-term behaviour of the system. In this paper the stability analysis of the system will be investigated. A crisp initial condition for each of the followers is assumed to show that there are two stable non-trivial equilibrium points.
