Both of them are co-existence equilibrium solutions, which indicates a plausible model. Some numerical examples are presented to illustrated properties of the model.

articleTitle: Development of Synoptic Automatic Weather Station Based on Internet of Thing at the Kemayoran Meteorological Station
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Automatic Weather Station is one of the instrumentation used in the Agency of Meteorological, Climatological, and Geophysics to collect weather information data. Real-time AWS that connected to the internet can be used as a data source for weather analysis and forecasting. BMKG recently uses the FTP protocol for AWS data communications. FTP-based data transmission has a disadvantage if the number of AWS sites is very large, there is a buildup of data on the FTP server so that the data is late on the FTP server. This study aims to design and develop realtime Automatic Weather Station to be connected to the internet network based on the HTTP protocol. The developed system consisted of meteorology sensor components, data loggers for data acquisition, power supply, and Machine to Machine-based cellular communication modules. The data sent from the data logger using serial module interface GPRS / 2G FXT009 and forwarded to a web server via HTTP protocol. These data displayed in a web browser in order for users to be able to know the weather changes every 10 minutes. The developed system was able to send 100 percent presentation data from 4463 data packages.

articleTitle: Analysis of Risk Priorities in a Medical Record Unit at the Hospital
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Hospitals are always required to improve the existing services in order to be competitive. Service improvement can be done by giving the best to the patients in every aspect, especially services in terms of patient care. However, currently patients at the Universitas Sumatera Utara (USU) Hospital often complain that they have to wait for a long time before a doctor examination in the clinic it to take place. This is because it takes a long time for the medical record to reach the clinic. Therefore, it is necessary to risk analysis that occurs in the process of medical record section to identify the cause most potentially causes the process in the medical record to be long. The study was conducted by applying FMEA and fishbone diagrams in analyzing the risks associated with the failures impact in the process flow of medical record documents. The result shows that the highest RPN value of 288 where the main cause of failure was due to files not brought back into place and the arrangement of files was not in order. Both of these result in a long process of file search that has an impact on the patient's treatment process and they become top priorities.

articleTitle: ZT: An Adaptive Learning Tool for Chinese L2 Learners
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Chinese language has the reputation of being difficult to learn because it has thousands of characters to memorize, four different tones, so a word can be pronounced four different ways with each pronunciation has a different meaning. On top of that, there are the homophones where words with the same pronunciations have different meanings. These difficulties do not stop thousands of hopefulChinese as second language learners (L2 learners) from trying. In this paper, ZT - an adaptive learning tool that is designed specifically to help Chinese L2 learners is proposed. ZT'S simple algorithm is based on the Leitner system and spaced repetition. The goal is to create a system that takes learner to gradually master new words and phrases along with its use in the sentence by daily practice and keep track of the progress. In an initial test using the System Usability Scale (SUS), ZT obtained a score of 76 which means it has a good usability, further tests are still needed to check on its effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Value Engineering in Crude Palm Oil Industry Design to Minimize Cost
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper provides an overview to find an alternative design by value engineering application to minimize the building cost in palm oil Industry. The company initial design used a 10 Tons FFB vertical sterilizer cap 4 units which cost IDR 8.857.183.300. Therefore, a brainstorming process is carried out to generate alternative designs are able to minimize the cost of building factories and space requirements while still meeting the company capacity of 40 tons per day. The study found 2 alternatives obtained from the results of brainstorming. The first alternative is to use a 15 Tons FFB vertical sterilizer cap of 3 units and the cost is reduced by 7,85% and the space requirements are reduced by 16,67%. Alternative 2 is to use a 20 Tons FFB vertical sterilizer cap of 2 units and costs are reduced by 19,02% and space requirements are reduced by 11,11%. The results obtained by conducting value engineering shows that the percentage of cost reduction by replacing the type of vertical sterilizer and the number of units capable of costs minimization and space requirements. The second alternative was chosen because it was able to costs minimization greater than the alternative 1.

articleTitle: Energy Management Assessment Measurement Using Three Measurement Approaches for Green Campus Concept
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper discusses the measurement of green campus assessments at a Siliwangi University, which has a total occupancy of 15973 people with an area of 50 Hectares The problem of the paper is how the level of the green campus from the energy aspect based on three measurement standards for the green campus. The method used in applying the measurement of energy ranking from three approaches, namely the UI Green Metric standards, the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) and Greenship version 1.1. The measurement results show that the University of Siliwangi still has a low score according to the three standard measurements. Using the UI GreenMatric, the energy aspect score obtained was at the 7% level, then accepted a score of 5 from the maximum value of 15 on the UNEP approach, and scored 23 on the Greenship version 1.1 approach. The program of providing new renewable energy sources for the UNSIL campus is needed in achieving a green campus. In addition to that, a conservation and efficiency program to reduce greenhouse gas emissions becomes a campus priority.

articleTitle: Aesthetic Affordances of Buto's Shape and Texture Characters in Wayang Kulit Through Digital Sculpting
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Javanese Wayang Kulit Puppetry through centuries has become high values for the Indonesian cultural aspect, normatively this monumental culture is also has become iconic sublime through “pakem”, its means, Wayang Kulit has the uniformity performance, including the storyline and the method of the delivering the story to protect the tradition, as a cultural asset Wayang should have progress in other unlimited creativity, rather than stagnant or involutif. Until now, Wayang Kulit became inspiration and thrills factor of creativity using the technology, such as in game, wayang has become playable game character, including the heroic and the vilain approaches from the original wayang characterization itself. The purpose of this research is to describe the creatives process and technical approach using digital sculpting that focus on shape and texture design of wayang kulit character, especially in “Buto” type of character, which is refers to giant monster based on humanoid wayang type. The methods of this research combine literatures study and experimental 3D CG model character creation. The analysis result is to gain alternative visualization in character design, focus on shape and texture from conceptual to visualization aesthetic that inspired by Wayang Buto type characterization.

articleTitle: Six Sigma Method for Improvement of Crude Palm Oil (CPO) Quality
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Companies engaged in oil palm plantations are still refusing products because of incompatibility oil quality specifications, therefore oil must be reprocessed. This study aims to control the quality of Crude Palm Oil (CPO) which has free fatty acid specification levels, moisture content and impurities by applying the concepts of DMAIC and FMEA. The study results indicate that there are some data outside the boundaries system and need to be revised. CTQ which is potential product crude palm oil is the level of free fatty acid which is less than 3.5% the water content is less than 0.15%. Process capability calculation still has a Cpk value below one which indicates there are several parts of the process variation located outside the specification limits. From measurement results, DPMO value are equal to 138,700 with the sigma value 2.59. FMEA is used to determine the main factors that cause a decrease in quality and the highest RPN value is 280 with causes of failure, operators are not careful and lack discipline in sorting fruit. The proposed improvement in product quality uses <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5\mathbf{W}+1\mathbf{H}$</tex> by making improvements to all sources of quality degradation such as making some improvements to the machine to work optimally and checking every level of raw materials that are in accordance with the standards and increasing inspection standards to maintain stability from routine process variations.

articleTitle: The Quality Metric Design to Control Quality of Telecommunication Construction Project Using Internal Control Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: A company has a telecommunication construction project. The company has given a contract to the vendor to carry out the project. During the execution phase, the vendor made a mistake on the installation thus reworking is required. After an observation, it turns out that in the planning phase the vendors do not carry out plan quality management that produce quality metric as a guide consists of specifications to control the quality. The absence of quality metric causes the vendor do not aware of the specifications that must be met in the project so reworking occurs. On this research, the design of quality metric using internal control methods is developed to identify possible errors and provide critical success criteria for each work activity. In addition, identification of critical activities is carried out using the Critical Path Method. To assess the results of implementation of quality metric, a quality checklist is designed. The assessment was used before and after the implementation of quality metric. The result of this research is quality metric has increased the performance of vendors by 23% but there are 10 statements that do not meet specifications and critical.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled 5G Autonomous Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Blockchain technology is getting more attention due to its inherent nature in resistance to data modification. Blockchain combined with IoT enables to improve the level of services for various domains with security guarantees. Numerous research has begun in order to link the blockchain along with autonomous vehicles system on 5G networks. Ultrafast connections, speedier data downloads, and the ability to handle millions of connections more than LTE networks are crucial to support a rapid autonomous system. Therefore, the system requires proper data storage management, high secure transaction, and non-interference network. The blockchain is suitable for the 5G vehicular system since it is immutable, tamper-proof, and secure by design. Although the decentralized 5G autonomous vehicular network provides countless benefits, yet it raises more than a few challenges. This paper provides an initial stage of the blockchain-enabled 5G vehicular networks, architecture, and technical aspects. Some remarks and challenges are also discussed.

articleTitle: Exploring The Drivers Of Mobile Based Peer To Peer Lending Application Service Quality In Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the drivers of peer to peer lending mobile application and to identify the significant driver of user satisfaction. The author employed critical incident technique to reveal the drivers of peer-to-peer lending mobile application service quality, sentiment analysis to identify significant drivers of user's satisfaction/dissatisfaction, and semi structured interview as triangulation to gain more insight of perceptions and understanding. The analysis obtained a total of 47 components node that identified as 15 drivers of peer-to-peer lending mobile application service quality. This research discovers responsiveness as most significant factors that impact user satisfaction, while information as the most significant factor for user dissatisfaction. Furthermore, peer-to-peer lending platforms company or new Financial Technology start-ups that intend to enter digital peer-to-peer lending market through mobile application may use 15 drivers service quality that identified from this research which taken directly from user perspectives incident.

articleTitle: Factors, Including Disasters, Affecting Sustainable Development- Focus on Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The term Sustainable Development started to appear about 30 years ago and its meaning widened over the years to encompass a comprehensive multi-disciplinary range of subjects that impact on global growth. Initially the subject areas dealt with social, economic and enironmental issues but Younger (2007) added the need to consider the political dimension in decision-making and this was expanded later when discussing the work of the East Bali Poverty Project (Younger et al, 2012). National development must work at all levels of society from top government down to the village community to be sustainable, with all levels appropriately engaged. The challenge for Indonesia is complex because of the archipelagic nature of the country with its 17,000 islands and widely differing populaton dispersion and cultural heritages. Further complications arise because of Indonesia's location on the earth's surface, straddling the most active tectonic area to be found on the planet. This, in turn, means the country is highly prone to natural disasters, which are manifest annually through some tectonic driven event, whether earthquake, volcanic eruption or tsunami, or simply from a landslide resulting from instability in a steep tropically weathered hillside. Disasters as annual events have to be considered within the scope of sustainable development, and the steady impact of urbanization over the next 30 years makes the subject areas within the scope of Sustainable Development vital both to academia and in practice.

articleTitle: Estimation Model using Cost Driver in Aggregate Level for Mould Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: A mould manufacturer is one of the examples of a make-to-order industry. Therefore, a quotation is very important as the response to the customer order and should be prepared very fast and accurately. Thus, this research focuses on developing the estimation model various mould maker industry for the long-term. Another development is determining whether the product is complex or not by using certain criteria. To be able to be used in a different company for the long-term, the configuration is made so that the company may change the software setting based on certain situations. For determining complex products, the software should check all product inputs with the criteria and give notes for the product which exceed the limit of the criteria. Then, the software will be validated and verified. The validation is done by comparing the manual calculation with the software calculation result. The verification is done by comparing the manual calculation with software calculation with different settings. The result shows no difference between manual and software calculations. Finally, the software is used to estimate some engineering drawings as inputs and compared with the actual time as a case study.

articleTitle: WOTEC Technology as the Potential Renewable Energy: Literature Study in East Nusa Tenggara
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: This paper aims to study the potential new ocean- based renewable energy sources called WOTEC as the combination of offshore wind and ocean thermal energy to generate electricity in East Nusa Tenggara (NTT). This paper mostly applies qualitative research method by collecting the secondary data and reviewing the experts of renewable energy. This paper uses the Transition Management Approach on Multi-Level System by Jan Rotman to examine the applicability WOTEC projects in NTT. This paper identifies that the potential of OTEC and offshore wind remain untapped and cannot be proceed to supply more electricity in NTT that has the lowest electrification ratio. It is estimated that WOTEC will be the largest source of renewable power generation as it will potentially generate electricity which much bigger (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{n}=844,134,728$</tex> kWh) than the one resulting from the aggregation of the entire power plant in NTT.

articleTitle: Multistage Fuzzy Inference System for Solving Problems in Performance Appraisal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Performance assessment can be used as a basis for the development of human resources and other decisions. This study discusses issues in the performance appraisal method, particularly how to design more objective methods to promote employees with trainee status as permanent employees. In the decision making method that is being used, there are many situation that should be better describe in qualitative description hence create some uncertainty and subjectivity in the assessment process. The existence of the nature of uncertainty and subjectivity in human judgment requires a method that can process it more objectively. This paper proposes a combination of QFD and pairwise comparison methods along with fuzzy inference system for redesigning the performance appraisal method that based on fuzzy logic approach. Simulation shows that at a certain value range, the proposed method decides ‘promotion canceled’ while current one decides ‘fail’. On the contrary, two ‘pass’ results change to ‘promotion canceled’. Possibly these are a better decision.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Absorptive Capacity, Knowledge Sharing Capability, and Green Dynamic Capability: A Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Various environmental problems that have occurred in recent years affect industrial activities, especially in the manufacturing industry. Companies must consider environmental aspects in carrying out their activities. For this reason, companies must make changes to their business processes so that they can adapt to various changes related to environmental issues. Green dynamic capability is one of the capabilities that can help companies change their business processes. This paper presents a conceptual model regarding the relationship between knowledge sharing ability, absorptive capacity, and green dynamic capability. This conceptual model illustrates how the ability to absorb knowledge and the ability to share knowledge can play a role in shaping the company's dynamic green capabilities. Four variables and three hypotheses are explained in the conceptual model which must be evaluated empirically at a later stage.

articleTitle: Designing Video Campaign Using Visual Rhetoric: Irony to Increase Awareness of Millennial In Using Social Media Wisely
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: Millennial generation is a generation that is close to a life of advance technologies that they are fluent in using the digital language of technologies, gadgets, games, and social media. The problems that can be identified are the negative impact of excessive use of gadgets for the millennial generation, lack of face-to-face communication while interacting with other people, and they use social media more than the ideal time. This research is about designing a persuasive video campaign using a theory of irony to increase millennial's awareness of using gadgets excessively could affect their social life. This study used qualitative research with a structured interview and participatory observation as data collecting methods. Then, it will be used as content for proposing a design solution. Based on the research, the success of video campaign is determined by the extent of visual rhetoric through ideas, compositions of value content, language style that is chosen, and way of delivering content, that changes the millennial's perception of using social media. The Irony theory became one of the important contents that are placed on the important scenes to add persuasion successfully. The higher the contrast between appearance and reality, the better the irony to be perceived.

articleTitle: Detection of Potentially Students Drop Out of College in Case of Missing Value Using C4.5
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Sustainable Engineering and Creative Computing (ICSECC)
abstract: The reputation of a university can be determined by the number of students drop out. This problem was experienced by many universities in Indonesia. It has been conducted by many researchers, however the data acquisition, attributes were not well explained. This study is aiming for giving projection related to the reasons behind students drop out by using machine learning technique. The challenging phase of preprocessing primary datasets are missing value, balanced class distribution, and a variety of data types. Two classes are applied: drop out and graduate students. By analyzing the problem of missing value data, it can reflect the basis of why students drop out or students who have the potential to drop out. According to the problem of balanced class distribution, Decision Tree algorithm is utilized, meanwhile for tackling the various of data types, we use C4.5. The result shows that 20 attributes using stratified sampling is the best of among all datasets and experimentations with an average AUC, accuracy, precision, and recall values of 0.98, 96.87, 98.75, and 97.84 respectively. It indicates that the proposed method is suitable for predicting students drop out with a balanced case of class distribution, despite having a missing data value problem.
